package orm_test

import (
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/tests/oracle"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

func captureLegacy(t *testing.T, site string, legacy any) {
	t.Helper()
	id := "orm_external/" + t.Name() + "/" + site + "/0"
	record := oracle.Observation{ID: id, Record: oracle.Record{Package: "orm_external", Site: site, Kind: "golden", Transcript: oracle.Snapshot(legacy)}}
	data, err := oracle.JSON(record)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	path := filepath.Join(os.Getenv("STAGE8D_CAPTURE"), oracle.Digest([]byte(id))+".record.json")
	f, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0600)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err = f.Write(data); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = f.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
